summary: Anthony Doerr’s World‑War‑II novel “All the Light We Cannot See” won the 2015 Pulitzer Prize for Fiction, adding to its critical acclaim and a National Book Award nomination. The awards also went to Stephen Adly Guirgis’s play “Between Riverside and Crazy” (Drama), Elizabeth Kolbert’s “The Sixth Extinction” (General Nonfiction), and works in history, biography, music and poetry. Administered by Columbia University, the Pulitzers remain among the most prestigious honors in journalism and letters.

The book, a National Book Award finalist and Doerr’s second novel, received rave reviews, with critics such as William T. Vollmann declaring it impossible to put down. Members of 30 rock band members merged into one face each .
Beatles look like Paul McCartney, Nirvana look like Kurt Cobain .
U2, Rolling Stones and Green Day are a bizarre blend .
summary: West Coast Shaving’s latest marketing stunt merges the faces of every member from 30 iconic rock bands into single composite portraits, creating a “face of rock” for each group. While some mash‑ups clearly highlight familiar features—Paul McCartney in The Beatles, Kurt Cobain in Nirvana, and Eddie Van Halen in Van Halen—others, like U2, the Rolling Stones, and Green Day, are more ambiguous. The company explained the project in a blog post, noting difficulties such as the “white‑and‑black mess” produced when trying to blend KISS’s makeup and the simple sunglasses‑and‑facial‑hair combo used for ZZ Top.

Rangers have promised to investigate the claims .
Ashley was given security over the icons and logos as part of the £5m loan .
summary: Rangers have launched an urgent investigation after documents on the UK Intellectual Property Office show that the club’s trademarks – including the “Ready” badge and mascot Broxi Bear – were transferred to SportsDirect.com Retail Ltd on March 25, part of the security for a £5 million loan given to the previous board. The move appears to give Newcastle United owner Mike Ashley control of the Light Blues’ icons, a development that has alarmed supporters who already resent his claim to a large share of the club’s retail income. Rangers’ new leadership says it is reviewing all related contracts and has denied any recent discussions with Ashley or Sports Direct.

Coutinho’s all‑action display – leading in shots, touches, duels, dribbles and tackles – capped a week in which he has scored five of his six goals to directly secure points for the Reds.

summary: Police are investigating the theft of 12 prize‑winning guinea pigs from top breeder Tony Tancock’s outbuilding in Crediton, Devon, after a thief left behind eight ordinary animals and took the show‑quality specimens. Tancock, who has won national awards, suspects the theft was carried out by someone with expert knowledge of cavy breeding, possibly a rival competitor, and has appealed for the pets’ safe return. The British Cavy Council’s chairman warned against assuming a competitor motive, urging vigilance at shows and secure storage, while officers ask anyone with information to call 101.
